# Ziqi Wang

> Ziqi (Zoe) Wang is a technical marketer in San Jose, California. She is a Technical Marketing Intern at Futurewei Technologies, holds an M.S. in Digital Social Media from the University of Southern California (2026) and a B.S. in Advertising from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (2024), and is a co-first author of L-MARS (ICML 2026 AI4Law workshop).

Not to be confused with the Chinese actor Wang Ziqi, or with researchers named Ziqi Wang at EPFL or Yale Law School.

## Work
- [IC News Daily](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/daily-news-push/): the daily market-intelligence newsletter she built for Futurewei's IC lab
- [AI search citation study](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/aeo-teardown/): which sources AI search engines cite when buyers ask about five AI companies
- [AI Attention Tracker](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/ai-attention-tracker/): a daily dashboard of AI topic trends
- [L-MARS](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/l-mars/): a legal AI system that checks each claim against its sources
- [SEO and B2B growth at CambioML](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/cambioml-seo/)
- [Short-form video and paid social at Echobend](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/echobend-social/)
- [Acure retail campaign](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/acure-campaign/)
- [CASPA event communications](https://ziqiwang-zoe.github.io/work/caspa/)
